title: Delta-encoded performance prober for CI PR gating
creator: Jon Barlow
description: Problem: PRs that touch the serving runtime or kernel selection can introduce subtle throughput or latency regressions (tokens/sec drops, p95 tail shifts) which are often only visible under representative load and warm cache conditions. Existing CI gating uses coarse CI baselines and occasional shadow runs; we need a lightweight, deterministic prober that fits into PR CI while surfacing regressions with low false positives.
solution_summary: Build a delta-encoded performance prober and CI harness that: (1) runs a fast, reproducible micro-workload on PRs (cold/warm variants), (2) encodes token/sec and latency time-series as compact deltas to compare against a rolling baseline, (3) applies robust statistical checks (Bayesian change detector + trimmed-mean p95 bootstrap) to flag regressions, and (4) emits artifacts (bench traces, summary JSON, Grafana link) that gating bots can use to block PRs or leave informative comments.
implementation_notes:
- Prober lives in infra/bench/probers/delta_prober; lightweight Go binary with CPU/GPU mode toggles.
- Workloads: micro (short seqs, high QPS), medium (typical user seq lengths), and p95-prober (longer seqs to stress cache/KV).
- Delta encoding: record per-iteration tokens/sec and p95 latency, then store differences from baseline median to make comparisons robust to cluster-wide shifts.
- Baseline: rolling window of nightly baseline builds + last green main commit. Baseline weight decays over 7 days.
- Statistics: combine a Bayesian online change detector for early failure with a bootstrap on trimmed p95 for final gating decision. Provide tunable thresholds per model and per infra class.
- CI integration: run fast micro-prober on every PR; if flagged, trigger a 30-minute enhanced run (larger sample) as confirmation. Failure blocks merge and posts a standardized comment with links to artifacts.
- Artifacts: JSON summary (tokens/sec, p95, delta), flame graphs, kernel selection logs, and a link to a temporary Grafana panel for in-depth inspection.
- Rollback plan: when gating fails incorrectly, allow heuristics to auto-unblock with human review and keep gated PR for root-cause (store data in S3).
risks:
- False positives from noisy infra or cold-start variance; mitigated with confirmation enhanced run and decaying baseline.
- Increased CI cost if enhanced runs are frequent; mitigate by rate-limiting enhanced confirmations and sampling by area.
- Cross-model variance: thresholds must be model-aware to avoid high false positive rates on quantized variants.
acceptance_criteria: Micro-prober runs in <90s for CPU mode and <60s for GPU mode in CI
Delta-encoded artifact generated and uploaded for every run
Gating bot blocks PR when confirmed regression detected and posts summary comment with links
False positive rate on historic PR corpus <3% after 2 weeks of tuning
Dashboards created for prober results and thresholds configurable per model
work_items: Design: finalize delta encoding format and schema for summary JSON
Engineering: implement prober runner + CI hook and artifact uploader
Infra: provision ephemeral tiny GPU instances for enhanced runs
QA: replay historical PRs to validate detection sensitivity and precision
Observability: Grafana panels and alerting for prober flaps
